unmatched.line: AI Paper and Peer Review Critique (2000-2500 words) 15 Dec Think back to that scoping exercise you did at the beginning of the term. Using MS Copilot or Perplexity, each person will produce a 1200 word essay on one of their questions using three prompts and asking it to use at least five sources of which two should be primary sources. You will then do a peer review of it using the library's physical and electronic resources. Your critique will focus on the arguments presented by and their scholarly foundations in the Gen AI produced essay. In other words, test GenAI by using your skills as a historian to identify the most scholarly resources against which you can compare what Gen AI produced. Did it hallucinate? Was it drawing on the most up to date or reliable sources? Did GenAI argue with more certainty that the evidence warranted? Was GenAI shaped by pre-existing perceptions or biases that might have coloured its conclusions. How compelling/persuasive was it? Did the structure of the argument work in its favour? Was there something missing?
